headline: Survey Finds 70% of Kenyans Lack Adequate Retirement Savings
summary: A financial survey indicated that seven in ten Kenyans are not adequately prepared for retirement, citing financial dependence from extended families and pension products oriented around formal employment.
why: Pension savings rates influence long-term domestic capital formation and national financial stability in emerging economies.

impacts.name: Kenya
impacts.why: Widespread retirement under-saving poses long-term social safety net challenges.
